note: The actor sends 9.306547 WETH into a four-pool cycle: WETH to USDC (V3 88e6), USDC to DAI (V3 5777), DAI to wstETH (V2 c557), and wstETH back to WETH (V3 d340). It receives 9.326484 WETH back, a gross gain of 0.019937 WETH, and the intermediate tokens pass directly from pool to pool. After the 0.017602 ETH gas fee the net is about +0.002335 ETH, which is the figure given as net_eth.
